summary: Fix D-056 substrate: ci/checks/agent-instruction-runtime-dormant.sh (FF-COMP-6) was RED on a clean dev checkout (dev@b50308be), masking npm run fitness's honest signal on every branch. Root cause: the src/http allowlist loop's detector (`grep -rlE "agent_instruction|agent-instruction"`) is file-level and comment-unaware — two pure documentation comments in src/http/agents.ts (byte-identical to origin/dev, naming the 'agent-instruction promote path' in prose) tripped it though agents.ts performs zero code-level table reads. The gate is right in spirit (day-1 no runtime response-formation path may read agent_instruction) — only its pattern was wrong. Added file_has_code_level_agent_instruction_hit() (comment-stripping re-scan) + wired it into the src/http loop before the pre-existing FAIL/BAD_HTTP increment (untouched, still the live FAIL path for any real violation) + 2 new --self-test probes. Diff against BASE_REF is 100% pure insertion (0 lines removed/modified) — verified both by manual diff and by ci/checks/auto-sanction-additive.sh --verify (A-1..A-4 PASS).
